title: Direct Synchronous Model Access
summary: This module provides synchronous functions for making direct, non-streamed and streamed requests to AI models. It wraps underlying asynchronous model request functionalities, allowing users to interact with models without managing an event loop directly.

nodes.label: User Application
nodes.title: User Application Code
nodes.description: The user's Python application code that initiates model requests using the synchronous API.

nodes.label: Synchronous Model Request
nodes.title: model_request_sync()
nodes.description: Initiates a blocking, non-streamed request to an AI model. It internally manages the asynchronous execution by running the async model request on an event loop.

nodes.label: Synchronous Streamed Request
nodes.title: model_request_stream_sync()
nodes.description: Initiates a blocking, streamed request to an AI model. It provides a synchronous iterator interface for consuming streamed responses by wrapping an asynchronous stream.

nodes.label: Asynchronous Model Request
nodes.title: model_request() (Async)
nodes.description: The core asynchronous function responsible for making non-streamed requests to AI models. It handles communication with model providers.

nodes.label: Asynchronous Streamed Request
nodes.title: model_request_stream() (Async)
nodes.description: The core asynchronous function responsible for making streamed requests to AI models. It yields chunks of the model's response as they become available.

nodes.label: Async Event Loop
nodes.title: Python Async Event Loop
nodes.description: The underlying mechanism that manages and executes asynchronous operations. It allows synchronous functions to await and retrieve results from asynchronous tasks.

nodes.label: Synchronous Stream Wrapper
nodes.title: StreamedResponseSync
nodes.description: A context manager that adapts an asynchronous streamed response into a synchronous iterator. It allows iterating over streamed data in a blocking manner.

nodes.label: AI Model Providers
nodes.title: External AI Models (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic)
nodes.description: External services or APIs that provide the actual AI model inference capabilities, receiving requests and returning responses or streamed data.

groups.label: Synchronous API
groups.title: Synchronous Access Layer
groups.description: Functions providing a blocking, synchronous interface for interacting with AI models, abstracting away asynchronous complexities.

groups.label: Asynchronous Core
groups.title: Underlying Asynchronous Logic
groups.description: The core asynchronous functions and mechanisms that handle actual model communication and event loop management.

groups.label: Stream Handling
groups.title: Streamed Response Management
groups.description: Components responsible for adapting asynchronous streamed responses into a synchronous, iterable interface for easier consumption.
